item.text: The feed already has a stable cursor for pagination, but the export only reads its first page. Several actions also lack event listeners, and project and comment edits do not emit events yet.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/repositories/activity-repository.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('gte, inArray, lt','gte, inArray, lt, lte').replace('      // The summary is the audited fact; the scalar bag is presentation-only\\n      // and is reconstructed by the readers that need it.\\n      metadata: \"{}\",','      metadata: JSON.stringify(event.metadata),').replace('    // Half-open on the right so consecutive windows tile without overlap:\\n    // [since, until) followed by [until, next).\\n','').replace('lt(activityEvents.occurredAt, input.until)','lte(activityEvents.occurredAt, input.until)'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schemas/activity.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('.extend(pageRequestSchema.shape);','.extend(pageRequestSchema.shape)\\n  .refine((value) => "'!value.since || !value.until || new Date(value.since) <= new Date(value.until), { message: "End must not precede start", path: ["until"] });'"').replace('  format: z.enum([\"csv\", \"json\"]).default(\"csv\"),\\n});','  format: z.enum([\"csv\", \"json\"]).default(\"csv\"),\\n}).refine((value) => new Date(value.since) <= new Date(value.until), { message: \"End must not precede start\", path: [\"until\"] });'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/types/event.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('  \"project.archived\":', '  \"project.updated\": EventEnvelope & { projectId: ProjectId; changedFields: readonly string[] };\\n  \"project.archived\":').replace('    mentionedUserIds: readonly UserId[];','    mentionedUserIds: readonly UserId[];\\n    projectId?: ProjectId;').replace('  \"comment.deleted\": EventEnvelope & { commentId: CommentId; issueId: IssueId };','  \"comment.updated\": EventEnvelope & { commentId: CommentId; issueId: IssueId; projectId?: ProjectId };\\n  \"comment.deleted\": EventEnvelope & { commentId: CommentId; issueId: IssueId; projectId?: ProjectId };'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/project-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('  return projectRepo.updateProject(input);','  const updated = await projectRepo.updateProject(input);\\n  await emit(\"project.updated\", {\\n    ...actorEnvelope(actor),\\n    projectId: updated.id,\\n    changedFields: Object.keys(input).filter((key) => key "'!== "orgId" && key !== "projectId"),'"\\n  });\\n  return updated;'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/comment-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('    issueId: comment.issueId,\\n    mentionedUserIds,','    issueId: comment.issueId,\\n    projectId: issue.projectId,\\n    mentionedUserIds,').replace('  return commentRepo.updateComment(input);','  const updated = await commentRepo.updateComment(input);\\n  const issue = requireFound(await issueRepo.findIssueById(input.orgId, updated.issueId), \"Issue\", updated.issueId);\\n  await emit(\"comment.updated\", { ...actorEnvelope(actor), commentId: updated.id, issueId: updated.issueId, projectId: issue.projectId });\\n  return updated;').replace('  await emit(\"comment.deleted\", {','  const issue = requireFound(await issueRepo.findIssueById(input.orgId, archived.issueId), \"Issue\", archived.issueId);\\n  await emit(\"comment.deleted\", {').replace('    issueId: archived.issueId,','    issueId: archived.issueId,\\n    projectId: issue.projectId,'); p.write_text(s)
PY"
